statement_summary: Program documented for IT and OT
CIP Senior Manager designated by name; delegations documented
Annual enterprise risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority; no safety risk above Low; NERC noncompliance never accepted
CIP-002 review every 15 months and at every OT project gate
Every Attachment 1 section in place on the day a substation becomes a low impact asset
Quarterly board reporting
Annual policy review; CIP policy every 15 months
Exceptions written, risk-rated, time-limited
Sanctions
Vendor security review and terms before access; yearly Tier 1 review; no vendor remote equipment at substations
OT supply chain requirements
Customer identity data minimized; Identity Theft Prevention Program maintained
Annual independent control evaluation
Records retention for security and CIP evidence
AI tools approved through governance before use
Unique accounts everywhere; shared SCADA admin accounts replaced by 2026-12-31
Role-based least privilege; bulk export and bulk command rights limited
Two-person rule for bulk AMI disconnects, switching orders, SCADA database changes
MFA for all remote and SaaS access; phishing-resistant for administrators
Privileged access through PAM, including OT
Vendor remote access only through jump hosts, off by default, logged, disableable, monitored
Routable access to low impact assets limited and checked after every change
No dial-up to substation devices
All IT-OT traffic through the OT DMZ; quarterly rule review
Same-day termination including OT; transfers within 5 days
Quarterly access reviews; inactive accounts disabled at 45 days
Substation physical access by need; keys reconciled; rekey on takeover
Device passwords unique, changed from defaults, vaulted
Lockout and screen lock, with HMI exemption
IR plan with two runbooks integrated with storm and crisis plans
Report suspected incidents immediately
Classify, log, track incidents with discovery time
Reportable Cyber Security Incident determination and E-ISAC notice
Manual operations safe state
Annual exercise; CIP 36-month limit; update within 90 days
External notifications per the P08 matrix
Client utilities notified within contract and statutory limits

Red Flags response steps

Minimize SSNs and driver license numbers; purge after 2 years

Client utility data separated and used only for contracted services
CEII and BES Cyber System Information labeled and shared only through controlled transfer
Disposal of paper, media, and OT devices
Encrypted, isolated backups
Records schedule
Annual acceptance
Awareness and phishing for all staff including field and DCC; role training
No personal use on OT devices and tablets
Removable media scanned before OT use
Only company laptops or reviewed contractor laptops on relays
No remote access equipment at substations without approval
Personal devices limited to email and chat
Only approved AI tools; no Restricted data in unapproved tools
Screen lock, lost device and phishing reporting
No bypassing controls
Monitoring notice
